electricityContract.terms: For full terms and conditions, please go to www.solsticeenergy.com.au

discounts.description: Discount is conditional on account holder being a member or affiliate as defined in the eligibility, and being a Solstice Energy customer at time of consumption. Discount applies to usage and daily supply charges, inclusive of GST. Discount does not apply to solar feed in tariff, or other fees and charges

electricityContract.variation: We will give you notice of any variation to the tariffs and/or charges that affect you at least 5 business days before the variation is to apply to you.

eligibility.description: To be eligible for this offer, you must receive and use a valid promo code provided by a club or association that has a current partnership with Solstice Energy, or be a member of such a club or association. Partnerships and associated offers may vary and are subject to specific eligibility criteria and expiry dates. To confirm whether your club or association is eligible, and to view applicable offer periods, please visit https://www.solsticeenergy.com.au/scoreboard#eligibility

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: Contract continues until terminated by you, or by us in accordance with our terms and conditions This product includes a discount of 5% on total bill that applies for the duration of the benefit period, once the benefit period finishes, the 5% discount will no longer apply. Before the end of the benefit period, we will let you know what your options are
electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: No credit card fees or late payment fees are applicable.
